findings.detail: B01 denominator appears to include both the 2025 current investment schedule and the separate prior-year schedule; current fair value ties to 8,108,654 while the prior schedule separately totals 7,244,282.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate B01 flag. The filing's current schedule total for December 31, 2025 ties to the extracted fund-quarter fair value of 8,108.654 million, so the failure is not a missing fair-value anchor. The raw source also contains a separate prior-period investment schedule totaling 7,244.282 million. The exact 222/444 fair-value coverage pattern is consistent with the report-date row universe admitting the comparative schedule alongside the current schedule, rather than a legitimate source omission.
